init_groq_model: initialize a GroqModel instance with a model name and API key for Groq chat completions
sample_text_groq: sample text from a prompt using the GroqModel with configurable temperature and max tokens
sample_choice_groq: sample a multiple choice answer from a list of responses using the GroqModel
configure_groq_measurements: configure a GroqModel with optional measurements tracking to publish raw text length data
review_groq_model_class: review the GroqModel class that wraps the Groq API for chat completion with few-shot prompting
